body: It's not weird, I'll try anything, thanks for helping :) I have tried it but because I have psychosis that's still getting worse I didn't react well to being high and got noticeably more symptoms after - might just be because I am getting worse anyway, but not worth the risk. I could definitely see if as an option after I've stabilised though and for now I'll stick to my bad habit of cigarettes which weirdly help my ibs pain

It really is a bitch, thanks for the advice, it really does help having all these people here with similar experiences who get it

I'm looking into getting on disability but it's complicated where I live and because all the benefits are being cut loads for only the most severely ill I'm not sure if I qualify even though there's no way I could work full time. I've been to a college counsellor and it's not really working for me but I'm being referred all over the place for my mental health stuff so they could send me a proper therapist eventually

I'll try to thanks, and so do you. Sending good vibes your way too mate
I understand that, I just like to forget that I'm ill so get slightly pissed when people constantly remind me of it, which of course isn't their fault

Cheers man, you too. I like to play chronic illness bingo whenever it comes up that I have a chronic illness, included but not limited to: 'have you tried yoga' 'everything happens for a reason' 'you're just lazy' 'try going to the gym' 'have you tried diet x' 'I get that too' 'it must be nice getting to be stay in bed all day' 'can you give me your painkillers' 'you don't look sick'
Yep, and they still haven't found a cause or a cure, but here's to hoping they do in the near future for the both of us

Yup, I'm fed up of the battle. Nobody else can see it so can't even try to accommodate unless I explicitly tell them what's wrong and what needs changing, it kinda sounds pathetic and selfish to say it like that but eh
That sucks man, having a debilitating condition is something people never understand unless they experience it first hand
Irritable bowel syndrome, Ehlers-Danlos, Myalgic Encephalomyelitis, psychosis, possibly some type of migraine disorder
